description: Blue-Ex Limited is a Karachi-based e-commerce logistics company, incorporated in 2005 as Universal Network Systems (Private) Limited. It launched the BlueEX brand and nationwide cash-on-delivery shipments in 2011, and describes itself as Pakistan's only fully integrated standalone e-commerce logistics player, covering the whole value chain from first-mile to last-mile delivery. It acquired the freight company UFS in 2023 and changed its name from Universal Network Systems Limited to Blue-EX Limited in 2024. The company says it is the only IATA-certified courier company in Pakistan.
